text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити wins the Tenno Sho (Весна)
against
Тамамо Кросс!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Watching Тамамо Кросс display raw
frustration,
Gold City realizes just how
preoccupied she's
been by everyone's
opinion of her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She hasn't been listening to her own
heart. But
now, she hears it scream with
the simple desire to
both run and win
more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The racecourse is where she wants to be,
and her
manager, moved to tears by the
heartfelt joy she
displayed on the track,
agrees that she should
continue racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Takarazuka Kinen, the
final race of
the Senior Spring Triple
Crown and our chance to
show Tamamo
Cross what Голд Сити's really made
of!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
